title: ERP-42
alt: ERP-42 autonomous research vehicle equipped with multiple sensors
description: We combine RTK-GNSS/IMU navigation with Pure Pursuit/PID control, route following, and vehicle–computer communication. Camera–3D LiDAR fusion supports object detection and obstacle avoidance, with field experiments at K-City.
